senses.en: a young person between 13 and 19 years old

example.en: My cousin became a teenager last week.
example.zh: 我表弟上周满十三岁了。

senses.en: far away in distance or time

example.en: The island is remote from the mainland.
They live in a remote mountain village.
example.zh: 他们住在一个偏僻的山村里。

example.en: There is only a remote chance of rain today.
example.zh: 今天下雨的可能性很小。

senses.en: a device for controlling a machine from a distance; remote control

example.en: He turned down the volume with the remote.
example.zh: 他用遥控器调低了音量。
